header: Price per unit, row by row
lead: One row per billable unit, the rate beside it, and a line saying how the unit is counted. Nothing is added up.
note: The note carries the billing terms — when the count is taken, how it appears on the invoice, whether tax is included.

rates.title: The unit is the row header
rates.text: So a rate read on its own still knows what it is a rate for.

rates.title: The rate keeps its own column
rates.text: Tabular figures, so the decimal points line up down the table.

rates.title: How it is counted is the third column
rates.text: The sentence that stops a rate from being argued about later.

rates.title: A total row
rates.text: Deliberately absent: the arithmetic belongs to the invoice.
